title: ZeroSim: Zero-Shot Analog Circuit Evaluation with Unified Transformer Embeddings
problem: Analog circuit performance evaluation requires expensive SPICE simulations. Existing neural surrogate models lack generalization to unseen topologies and design variants.
motivation: Accelerating analog circuit design requires fast, generalizable performance prediction without retraining for new topologies.
method: Transformer-based encoder with unified embeddings for circuit components and topology-agnostic architecture. Zero-shot inference on unseen topologies by leveraging learned component interactions. Achieves 13× speedup compared to SPICE simulation.
key_novelty: Zero-shot generalization to unseen circuit topologies using transformer embeddings without retraining.
contributions: Unified transformer embedding scheme for circuit components
limitations: Analysis limited to abstract; actual generalization scope to different circuit families and corner cases unknown.
